summary: AssemblyAI speaker identification failed for this meeting, so no AssemblyAI guess or existing map was available; all names come from self-identification, chair handoffs and the minutes. Three public hearings with 15 residents and 3 developer/applicant speakers. Letter C merges four people (City Manager, Resident 5, end of Resident 13, Delvecchio) and is fixed by overrides; Delvecchio is split across C and Z. Bill Hiebert (V) rests on the seconder pattern and Jac Siemens (W) on elimination - worth a listen to confirm they are not swapped. Short chair fragments sit on H, AD, AG; AA, AC, E, H are low.
